task.title: To View Standard or Alternate Clauses

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced and open the required agreement document. For more information on how to open an agreement document, see Opening a Contract Document.
Open the list of available clauses from the Contracts pane by selecting Doc Clauses from the Work tab.

Standard clauses with associated alternate clauses are indicated by a split arrow icon (). You can hover over the icon to see the availability of the alternate clause. Alternate clauses also indicate associated standard clauses using the split arrow icon.
Click the Expand icon () adjacent to the clause name and click View Standard / Alternates.
